properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: MD5 is used for generating IDs and authentication tokens in various parts of the system. These are security-critical usages that make the system vulnerable to collision attacks.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: 3DES cipher is used in protocol buffer configurations for defining destination overrides. This is an insecure cipher that should be replaced with AES-256-GCM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Poly1305 is used for message authentication in several encryption protocols. While this is not inherently insecure, it's part of the broader crypto landscape that needs evaluation.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Non-cryptographic PRNGs are used in various parts of the codebase including tests and utility functions. These should be replaced with proper CSPRNGs for security-sensitive contexts.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA signatures using P-256 and P-384 curves are used for certificate generation in TLS configurations and tests. These need migration to post-quantum signature schemes like ML-DSA or SLH-DSA.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Static initialization vectors are used in VMess AEAD implementations, which makes the encryption vulnerable to attacks due to IV reuse.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-224 is used in Trojan protocol configuration files. This is a weak hash function that should be replaced with SHA-384 or better.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: CTR/CFB/OFB modes are used in VLESS protocol encryption which can be vulnerable to various attacks compared to GCM or other authenticated encryption modes.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDH with X25519 is used for key agreement in TLS configurations and other crypto operations. This is a retroactively breakable classical algorithm that requires migration to post-quantum alternatives.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-256 curve is used in TLS certificate generation for ECDSA signatures. This needs migration to post-quantum signature schemes.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: P-384 and P-521 elliptic curves are used in test configurations for MASQUE protocol. These classical curves need migration to post-quantum alternatives.
